purpose: Capture the author Lean usage signal at the time each newest nonconditioning memory is scored for pruning, to supply a causally available historical-usage control for the existing source-level fixed-read diagnostics.
method: Wrap the existing _dump_retained_tokens_record call without modifying its inputs or outputs. Save detached usage_scores, keep_idx and source/read frame identities. The hook runs regardless of whether the author's optional diagnostic dump is enabled. Reuse the exact verified automatic raw-window capture, fixed prompts, token budget and preprocessing. No labels, new threshold, redetection, alternate model forward or feedback are introduced.
causality_and_alignment: Only use source usage measured on its subsequent read before the target read. Require source frame < target-1, measure time < target, and exact matching between stored keep indices and captured 64x64 source token IDs. Compare measured raw usage at selected source+1 reads against the corresponding slice of the previously frozen attention statistic and verify all trajectory and mask hashes against the previous capture. Reject missing, ambiguous, reordered or duplicated mappings; never substitute attention from the current target read.
engineering: First run the short seq3 gate using the existing feature/read engineering reference. Check all masks, records, selections and memory positions against that reference. Independently compare raw usage to frozen attention-stat slices and retained token identities. Only after successful gate capture the non-priority source sequences seq2, seq4, seq9 and seq10 once each and compare against their previously independently verified trajectories. Keep priority sequences reserved. Artifacts are in the user's Drive experiment folder.
limitations: The author usage is query-specific at the subsequent source read and is one prior relevance signal, not true marginal token utility. Source-level aggregation and comparisons to RGB, shuffled and distributed policies must be separately defined. These sequences and outcomes were previously inspected and patient independence is unverified.
